title: My Grandma Is Actually a Stunt Legend! 🏍️
topic: Nani reveals her secret past as a stunt driver during a wild scooter jump.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Nani, hold on tight because we are actually about to fly over Principal Huda’s entire backyard [beat] and I think I’m honestly gonna barf!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Stop whining like a little puppy, Nix, and just watch how a real professional [beat] handles a vintage engine under this much pressure!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I heard that engine from a mile away and I knew exactly which crazy woman [beat] was trying to ruin my expensive flower beds at midnight!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Oh shut it, Huda, you were always a terrible student [beat] and you still haven't learned how to properly land a ramp jump without crying!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait a second, why is the most terrifying principal in the history of school [beat] calling my grandma by her first name right now?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Because before I was your principal, I was just the annoying little brother [beat] who had to clean the grease off her stunt bikes every weekend!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Nani! I told you twenty years ago that your stunt career was over [beat] and here you are teaching my son how to break his neck!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Lubna, darling, your son has more natural talent in his pinky than your brother ever had [beat] in his entire pathetic career as a principal!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: I knew there was a reason why Nani’s old leather jacket [beat] had 'The Midnight Queen' embroidered on the back in sparkly gold thread!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: So you mean to tell me my grandma is a legendary stunt driver [beat] and the principal is her failed apprentice who went into education?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I didn't fail, I just chose a life where I don't have to jump over houses [beat] to pay my monthly electricity bills, thank you very much!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Whatever helps you sleep at night, Huda, but Nix and I have a city circuit to finish [beat] so get your boring feet off my runway!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I guess having a grandma who is literally a local legend [beat] is way better than having a grandma who just knits ugly sweaters all day!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how Nix discovered that his family tree [beat] was actually just one long line of adrenaline-fueled street racing legends.
